items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the commutativity of two Gysin pullbacks at source lines 3788-3801, label lemma-gysin-commutes-gysin, whose proof occupies source lines 3803-3864. The proof reduces to the class of a single integral closed subspace, then normalises meromorphic sections of the two restricted invertible sheaves so that they agree with the given sections outside the respective divisors, and rewrites each of the two composites as a locally finite sum over prime divisors weighted by orders in the henselizations of the local rings at their generic points. The identification of the two expressions is not immediate, because the two sums are indexed by different divisors; it is the key formula that produces a rational equivalence between them, and the bookkeeping consists in checking that the boundary terms vanish precisely at the prime divisors outside the intersection. The counted statement records none of this.
